gbm_population_evidence.quote: Clear Cell Renal Cell Carcinoma and Glioblastoma
Patients with glioblastoma or clear cell renal cell carcinoma

candidate_evidence.quote: This clinical trial aims to evaluate the diagnostic value of 68Ga-XT771, a CAIX/CAXII protein-specific probe, in PET/CT imaging for patients with clear cell renal cell carcinoma and glioblastoma.

role_evidence.quote: 68Ga-XT771: 68Ga-XT771 is injected intravenously with a dose of 4-8 mCi
evaluate the diagnostic value of 68Ga-XT771, a CAIX/CAXII protein-specific probe, in PET/CT imaging

coder_notes: Diagnostic PET tracer only; no therapeutic agent. CAIX/CAXII is the imaging target and appears only in title-level/summary text and keywords, not as eligibility, design or outcome biomarker, so no biomarker row. Early Phase 1 (translational subset). Arm label is 'Participant Group' (description starts 'Experimental: ...'); the 11C-MET, 18F-FDG and 68Ga-DPI-4552 scans are comparator imaging tracers mentioned only in the arm text, not registered interventions, so not listed.
